page: Microsoft Azure DC64es_v6 is a virtual machine instance belonging to the DCEV6 server family. It is powered by an Intel processor utilizing the x86_64 CPU architecture. The instance features 64 dedicated virtual CPUs and 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory allocation of 4.0 GB per core. Virtualization is managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

This server configuration does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external Premium Storage options, which the instance is capable of supporting. There are zero GPUs integrated into this configuration, and it does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the DC64es_v6 offers a high density of dedicated vCPUs and memory resources within the Intel-based hardware class. The lack of bundled local storage and GPU hardware reduces base infrastructure overhead for workloads that rely entirely on network-attached storage. This profile is suitable for memory-optimized enterprise workloads, database hosting, and general-purpose applications requiring substantial parallel processing capabilities without local disk dependencies.
